definition: knowing a lot about a subject
sentence: The guide was {knowledgeable} about every building in the old town.
translation: Гид знал всё о каждом здании старого города.

definition: women's underwear and night clothes
sentence: The shop sells silk {lingerie} at very high prices.
translation: Магазин продаёт шёлковое нижнее бельё по очень высоким ценам.

definition: the soft substance inside bones that makes blood cells
sentence: The patient needs a {marrow} transplant from a matching donor.
translation: Пациенту нужна пересадка костного мозга от подходящего донора.

definition: extremely good or enjoyable
sentence: We had a {marvelous} evening with old friends and good wine.
translation: Мы провели чудесный вечер со старыми друзьями и хорошим вином.

definition: able to cure illness, used about plants and substances
sentence: The monks grew {medicinal} herbs in the garden behind the church.
translation: Монахи выращивали лекарственные травы в саду за церковью.

definition: relating to the medical care of children
sentence: She works in the {pediatric} ward of the city hospital.
translation: Она работает в детском отделении городской больницы.

definition: to change something so it suits one person, or to add their name to it
sentence: You can {personalize} the mug with a name or a photo.
translation: Кружку можно персонализировать, добавив имя или фото.

definition: full of fun and not serious
sentence: The {playful} puppy chased its own tail round the garden.
translation: Игривый щенок гонялся за собственным хвостом по саду.

definition: unusual in an attractive or interesting way
sentence: The cafe has a {quirky} charm, with chairs that do not match.
translation: У кафе своеобразное очарование: ни один стул не похож на другой.

definition: the set of reasons behind a decision or belief
sentence: The minister explained the {rationale} for closing the small schools.
translation: Министр объяснил обоснование закрытия маленьких школ.

definition: the act of improving a system, or the religious movement of the 1500s
sentence: The {reformation} of the tax system took a whole decade.
translation: Реформирование налоговой системы заняло целое десятилетие.

definition: the science of designing and building robots
sentence: She studied {robotics} and now builds machines that pick fruit.
translation: Она изучала робототехнику и теперь строит машины для сбора фруктов.

definition: rain that flows off the land into rivers, or a second vote for a winner
sentence: Farm {runoff} carries fertilizer into the lake every spring.
translation: Сток с полей каждую весну несёт в озеро удобрения.

definition: a hot red sauce that you eat with chips
sentence: Dip the chips in the {salsa} before it gets warm.
translation: Макай чипсы в сальсу, пока она не нагрелась.

definition: showing feelings of love or sadness too strongly, or valued for memories
sentence: The old watch has only {sentimental} value; it stopped years ago.
translation: Старые часы дороги только как память, они давно остановились.

definition: happening at exactly the same time
sentence: The two explosions were {simultaneous}, so nobody could tell which came first.
translation: Два взрыва прогремели одновременно, и никто не мог сказать, какой был первым.

definition: strange and frightening in a way that makes you think of ghosts
sentence: The empty house looked {spooky} in the moonlight.
translation: Пустой дом в лунном свете выглядел жутковато.

definition: the quality of moving or acting quietly and secretly
sentence: The cat approached the bird with great {stealth}.
translation: Кошка подкрадывалась к птице очень осторожно.

definition: a feeling of excited uncertainty about what will happen next
sentence: The film keeps you in {suspense} until the last minute.
translation: Фильм держит в напряжении до последней минуты.

definition: the rules for arranging words into sentences in a language
sentence: Her {syntax} is perfect, but her accent gives her away.
translation: Её синтаксис безупречен, но акцент её выдаёт.

definition: a bicycle for two riders, one behind the other
sentence: They rode a {tandem} along the river path.
translation: Они ехали на тандеме по тропе вдоль реки.

definition: to show something on TV
sentence: The station will {televise} the final live on Sunday.
translation: Канал покажет финал в прямом эфире в воскресенье.

definition: third in order, or relating to education after school
sentence: The country wants half of all young people in {tertiary} education.
translation: Страна хочет, чтобы половина молодёжи получала высшее образование.

definition: a gland in the neck that controls how fast the body uses energy
sentence: Her {thyroid} was too active, so she lost weight and could not sleep.
translation: Её щитовидная железа работала слишком активно, она худела и не могла спать.

definition: arranged neatly with everything in its place
sentence: Keep your desk {tidy} so you can find things.
translation: Держи стол в порядке, чтобы всё можно было найти.

definition: not affected by the passing of time or by changing fashions
sentence: The white shirt is a {timeless} piece that never goes out of style.
translation: Белая рубашка — вещь вне времени, которая никогда не выходит из моды.

definition: not able to be trusted or depended on
sentence: The old car is {unreliable}, so we take the train in winter.
translation: Старая машина ненадёжна, поэтому зимой мы ездим на поезде.

definition: happy and full of hope
sentence: The coach was {upbeat} after the draw and praised the young players.
translation: После ничьей тренер был настроен оптимистично и хвалил молодых игроков.

definition: able to be used
sentence: The old bridge is still {usable} by walkers but not by cars.
translation: Старым мостом ещё могут пользоваться пешеходы, но не машины.

definition: the people who lead new developments or ideas
sentence: The small studio was in the {vanguard} of computer animation.
translation: Маленькая студия была в авангарде компьютерной анимации.

definition: rude and likely to offend, or showing bad taste
sentence: His {vulgar} jokes embarrassed everyone at the dinner.
translation: Его пошлые шутки смутили всех за ужином.

definition: an event that marks an important change
sentence: The election was a {watershed} in the country's history.
translation: Выборы стали переломным моментом в истории страны.

definition: the system of wires that carries electricity through a building
sentence: The old {wiring} in the house needs replacing before it causes a fire.
translation: Старую проводку в доме нужно заменить, пока она не вызвала пожар.

definition: to block a road or passage, or to prevent something from happening
sentence: Parked cars {obstruct} the entrance to the fire station.
translation: Припаркованные машины перегораживают выезд из пожарной части.

definition: a person who fits and repairs water pipes and bathrooms
sentence: The {plumber} fixed the leak under the sink in ten minutes.
translation: Сантехник починил течь под раковиной за десять минут.

definition: a person who climbs mountains or rocks, or a plant that grows up walls
sentence: The {climber} reached the top just as the storm began.
translation: Альпинист достиг вершины, как раз когда началась буря.

definition: a place where things are stored, especially data or documents
sentence: The library is a {repository} of maps going back five centuries.
translation: Библиотека — хранилище карт за пять столетий.

definition: to be more important or valuable than something else
sentence: The benefits of the new road {outweigh} the cost.
translation: Польза от новой дороги перевешивает затраты.

definition: the amount of work a person or machine has to do
sentence: Her {workload} doubled when two colleagues left.
translation: Её нагрузка удвоилась, когда ушли двое коллег.

definition: to stop something before it is finished because of a problem
sentence: The pilot had to {abort} the landing because of fog.
translation: Пилоту пришлось прервать посадку из-за тумана.

definition: to keep complaining to someone or asking them to do something
sentence: My mother used to {nag} me about my untidy room.
translation: Мать постоянно пилила меня за беспорядок в комнате.

definition: a rounded part of an organ, or the soft lower part of the ear
sentence: The scan showed a shadow on the left {lobe} of the lung.
translation: Снимок показал затемнение на левой доле лёгкого.

definition: to leave a room, building or seat so it is free for others
sentence: Guests must {vacate} their rooms by eleven in the morning.
translation: Гости должны освободить номера до одиннадцати утра.

definition: to change the structure or shape of a building or room
sentence: They plan to {remodel} the kitchen and knock down a wall.
translation: Они планируют перестроить кухню и снести стену.

definition: to read something quickly, or to remove something from the surface of a liquid
sentence: I only had time to {skim} the report before the meeting.
translation: Перед совещанием я успел лишь бегло просмотреть отчёт.

definition: dirt that has built up on a surface over time
sentence: Years of {grime} covered the kitchen windows.
translation: Многолетняя грязь покрывала кухонные окна.

definition: to practise a play, speech or piece of music before performing it
sentence: The band will {rehearse} every evening this week.
translation: На этой неделе группа будет репетировать каждый вечер.

definition: to make something more beautiful by adding decoration
sentence: Flowers {adorn} every balcony in the old town in May.
translation: В мае цветы украшают каждый балкон старого города.

definition: a very poor and crowded area of a city with bad housing
sentence: She grew up in a {slum} and became a doctor.
translation: Она выросла в трущобах и стала врачом.

definition: to fall suddenly by a large amount, or to sit or fall heavily
sentence: Sales {slump} every January after the holidays.
translation: Каждый январь после праздников продажи резко падают.

definition: the long tube in the body that carries food from the stomach
sentence: Food takes several hours to pass through the {intestine}.
translation: Пища проходит через кишечник за несколько часов.

definition: a list showing the times at which trains leave, or lessons start
sentence: Check the {timetable}; the last train leaves at eleven.
translation: Проверь расписание, последний поезд уходит в одиннадцать.

definition: a trace of something bad that spoils a person's reputation or a thing
sentence: The {taint} of the scandal followed him for years.
translation: Пятно скандала преследовало его годами.

definition: to break or burst suddenly
sentence: The pipe may {rupture} if the water freezes inside it.
translation: Труба может лопнуть, если вода в ней замёрзнет.

definition: a small animal with eight legs and a curved tail that stings
sentence: Shake out your boots; a {scorpion} may be hiding inside.
translation: Вытряхни ботинки, внутри может прятаться скорпион.

definition: the way a person's hair is cut and arranged
sentence: Her new {hairstyle} is short at the back and long at the front.
translation: Её новая причёска короткая сзади и длинная спереди.

definition: a very bad headache that often comes with sickness and sensitivity to light
sentence: A {migraine} kept her in a dark room all day.
translation: Мигрень продержала её весь день в тёмной комнате.

definition: thin mist or smoke in the air that makes it hard to see clearly
sentence: A {haze} of smoke from the fires hung over the city.
translation: Над городом висела дымка от пожаров.

definition: to make something less heavy, less dark or less serious
sentence: A joke will {lighten} the mood before the hard questions.
translation: Шутка разрядит обстановку перед трудными вопросами.

definition: a small creature like a worm with many legs that turns into a butterfly
sentence: A green {caterpillar} was eating a hole in the cabbage leaf.
translation: Зелёная гусеница проедала дыру в листе капусты.

definition: a judgement of the value or quality of something or someone's work
sentence: Every employee has a yearly {appraisal} with their manager.
translation: У каждого сотрудника раз в год проходит оценка работы с руководителем.

definition: a small piece of jewellery that hangs on a chain around the neck
sentence: She wore a silver {pendant} shaped like a star.
translation: Она носила серебряный кулон в форме звезды.

definition: to push something out with force, or to make someone leave a place
sentence: The guards had to {eject} two drunk fans from the stadium.
translation: Охране пришлось вывести двух пьяных болельщиков со стадиона.

definition: the crime of entering a building to steal
sentence: There were three cases of {burglary} on our street last month.
translation: В прошлом месяце на нашей улице было три квартирные кражи.

definition: a small yellow bird kept as a pet for its singing
sentence: The {canary} sang in its cage by the window.
translation: Канарейка пела в клетке у окна.

definition: a plant with unusual brightly coloured flowers, often grown indoors
sentence: An {orchid} flowered on her desk for three months.
translation: Орхидея цвела у неё на столе три месяца.

definition: a bunch of flowers arranged attractively, often given as a gift
sentence: The bride carried a {bouquet} of white roses.
translation: Невеста несла букет белых роз.

definition: a substance the body produces when you are excited or frightened, giving you energy
sentence: The {adrenaline} of the race kept her awake all night.
translation: Адреналин от гонки не давал ей уснуть всю ночь.

definition: a situation with no government or order, in which people do as they like
sentence: After the president fled, the capital fell into {anarchy}.
translation: После бегства президента в столице воцарилась анархия.

definition: onto the land from the sea or a boat
sentence: The sailors came {ashore} for the first time in three months.
translation: Моряки сошли на берег впервые за три месяца.

definition: a feeling or quality that seems to surround a person or place
sentence: The old library has an {aura} of calm and learning.
translation: Старая библиотека окружена атмосферой покоя и знания.

definition: a very large room used for formal dancing
sentence: The hotel's {ballroom} holds five hundred guests.
translation: Бальный зал отеля вмещает пятьсот гостей.

definition: able to speak two languages equally well
sentence: The children are {bilingual} because their mother speaks Spanish at home.
translation: Дети двуязычные, потому что мать говорит дома по-испански.

definition: a cover above a bed or seat, or the leaves high up in a forest
sentence: Monkeys live high in the forest {canopy} and rarely come down.
translation: Обезьяны живут высоко в кронах деревьев и редко спускаются.

definition: having an advanced culture and polite behaviour
sentence: Let us settle this in a {civilized} way, over coffee.
translation: Давай решим это цивилизованно, за кофе.

definition: very strong public criticism
sentence: The attack drew {condemnation} from every government in Europe.
translation: Нападение вызвало осуждение всех правительств Европы.

definition: a strong blue cloth that jeans are made of
sentence: She wore a {denim} jacket over a white dress.
translation: На ней была джинсовая куртка поверх белого платья.

definition: small drops of water that form on grass and leaves during the night
sentence: The grass was wet with {dew} when we set off at dawn.
translation: Трава была мокрой от росы, когда мы отправились на рассвете.

definition: not telling the truth, or trying to cheat people
sentence: It was {dishonest} to sell the car without mentioning the crash.
translation: Было нечестно продать машину, не упомянув об аварии.

definition: not sure, or unlikely to happen
sentence: It is {doubtful} that the match will go ahead in this rain.
translation: Сомнительно, что матч состоится в такой дождь.

definition: a situation in which something, such as a family, does not work properly
sentence: Years of {dysfunction} in the company ended with its sale.
translation: Годы неразберихи в компании закончились её продажей.

definition: a book or website with information about many subjects in alphabetical order
sentence: As a child he read the {encyclopedia} from A to Z.
translation: В детстве он прочитал энциклопедию от А до Я.

definition: to cut words or a design into metal, stone or glass
sentence: The jeweller will {engrave} the date inside the ring.
translation: Ювелир выгравирует дату на внутренней стороне кольца.

definition: the act of improving the quality of something by adding to it
sentence: Music lessons are a form of {enrichment} that the school offers for free.
translation: Уроки музыки — дополнительное развитие, которое школа предлагает бесплатно.

definition: all the animals living in a particular area
sentence: The island's {fauna} includes a lizard found nowhere else.
translation: Фауна острова включает ящерицу, которой нет больше нигде.

definition: faithfulness to a partner, or exactness in copying something
sentence: The recording has such {fidelity} that you hear the singer breathe.
translation: Запись такой точности, что слышно дыхание певца.

definition: in very small pieces, or with great care and precision
sentence: Chop the onion {finely} and fry it until golden.
translation: Мелко нарежь лук и обжарь до золотистого цвета.

definition: able to speak or write a language easily and well
sentence: She became {fluent} in Italian after a year in Rome.
translation: После года в Риме она стала свободно говорить по-итальянски.

definition: the leading position in an activity or movement
sentence: The lab is at the {forefront} of research into batteries.
translation: Лаборатория находится на переднем крае исследований батарей.

definition: water that is not salty, found in rivers and lakes, or living in it
sentence: Trout are {freshwater} fish and cannot live in the sea.
translation: Форель — пресноводная рыба и не может жить в море.

definition: extremely unpleasant or full of hate
sentence: The {hateful} comments under the video were removed.
translation: Злобные комментарии под видео были удалены.

definition: a serious disease of the liver
sentence: The clinic offers a free vaccine against {hepatitis}.
translation: Клиника предлагает бесплатную прививку от гепатита.

definition: the act of starting something, or a ceremony for joining a group
sentence: The club has an {initiation} in which new members sing a song.
translation: В клубе есть ритуал посвящения, во время которого новички поют песню.

definition: to an extreme degree, or with great concentration
sentence: She stared {intensely} at the screen, looking for the error.
translation: Она напряжённо всматривалась в экран в поисках ошибки.

definition: danger of harm, loss or failure
sentence: The whole project is in {jeopardy} because of the delay.
translation: Из-за задержки под угрозой весь проект.

definition: a situation in which people must stay inside because of danger or disease
sentence: During the {lockdown} the streets were empty for weeks.
translation: Во время локдауна улицы неделями были пусты.

definition: not shiny, used about paint, paper or finishes
sentence: She chose a {matte} paint for the walls to hide the marks.
translation: Она выбрала матовую краску для стен, чтобы скрыть пятна.

definition: of only average quality, not very good
sentence: The food was {mediocre} and the service was slow.
translation: Еда была посредственной, а обслуживание медленным.

definition: the substance in tobacco that makes people addicted to smoking
sentence: The patch gives a small dose of {nicotine} through the skin.
translation: Пластырь даёт небольшую дозу никотина через кожу.

definition: relating to how something appears on the outside, or going away from a place
sentence: Her {outward} calm hid a lot of worry.
translation: Её внешнее спокойствие скрывало большую тревогу.

definition: to think something is better or more important than it really is
sentence: Critics tend to {overrate} any film with a sad ending.
translation: Критики склонны переоценивать любой фильм с грустным концом.

definition: attacking ships to steal, or illegally copying films, music or software
sentence: Music {piracy} fell when cheap streaming arrived.
translation: Пиратство в музыке снизилось с появлением дешёвого стриминга.

definition: a small group of soldiers led by a lieutenant
sentence: The {platoon} marched for ten hours through the mud.
translation: Взвод десять часов шёл маршем по грязи.

definition: remaining after most of something has gone
sentence: There is still some {residual} pain in the knee a year after the operation.
translation: Через год после операции в колене остаётся небольшая боль.

definition: a dark grain used for making bread and strong drinks
sentence: The dark {rye} bread goes well with smoked fish.
translation: Тёмный ржаной хлеб хорошо идёт с копчёной рыбой.

definition: causing great excitement or interest, or extremely good
sentence: The paper ran a {sensational} story about the mayor's secret life.
translation: Газета опубликовала сенсационную историю о тайной жизни мэра.

definition: the unfair treatment of people because of their sex, especially women
sentence: She complained about {sexism} in the company's hiring.
translation: Она пожаловалась на сексизм при найме в компании.

definition: doing things secretly and dishonestly
sentence: It was {sneaky} to read her diary while she was out.
translation: Было подло читать её дневник, пока её не было.

definition: suffering or death caused by having no food
sentence: Thousands faced {starvation} when the harvest failed.
translation: Тысячи людей оказались на грани голода, когда урожай погиб.

definition: in a way that follows a fixed plan or method
sentence: The police searched the house {systematically}, room by room.
translation: Полиция методично обыскала дом, комнату за комнатой.

definition: an agreement between enemies to stop fighting for a time
sentence: The two armies agreed a {truce} for Christmas Day.
translation: Две армии договорились о перемирии на Рождество.

definition: a very large wave caused by an earthquake under the sea
sentence: The {tsunami} swept boats a kilometre inland.
translation: Цунами унесло лодки на километр вглубь суши.

definition: a state of great confusion, worry or disorder
sentence: My life was in {turmoil} after the move.
translation: После переезда моя жизнь была в полном раздрае.

definition: cruel and unfair government by a person or group with total power
sentence: The people rose up against the {tyranny} of the king.
translation: Народ восстал против тирании короля.

definition: not in good physical condition, or not suitable
sentence: After a winter indoors he was too {unfit} to climb the hill.
translation: После зимы в четырёх стенах он был слишком не в форме, чтобы подняться на холм.

definition: the state of feeling healthy and happy
sentence: Regular sleep matters more to your {wellbeing} than any vitamin.
translation: Регулярный сон важнее для самочувствия, чем любые витамины.

definition: a fixed amount of money paid to someone every year, often from insurance
sentence: Her pension pays an {annuity} of ten thousand a year.
translation: Её пенсия выплачивает ежегодную ренту в десять тысяч.

definition: a small gun that can be held and fired with one hand
sentence: The guard carried a {handgun} on his belt.
translation: Охранник носил пистолет на поясе.

definition: a piece of music for two singers or players, or the two performers
sentence: The brother and sister sang a {duet} at the wedding.
translation: Брат и сестра спели дуэтом на свадьбе.

definition: a form in which a spirit, idea or thing appears, or one of several versions
sentence: In its latest {incarnation} the cafe sells only tea and cake.
translation: В своём нынешнем воплощении кафе продаёт только чай и пирожные.

definition: a grain used for making porridge and feeding horses
sentence: The horse ate a bucket of {oats} after the race.
translation: После скачек лошадь съела ведро овса.

definition: to come together from different directions at one point
sentence: Three rivers {converge} just below the old bridge.
translation: Три реки сливаются прямо под старым мостом.

definition: a group of stars that forms a pattern with a name
sentence: The {constellation} of Orion is easy to find in winter.
translation: Созвездие Ориона легко найти зимой.

definition: having a strong sour taste like a lemon
sentence: The apples were too {tart} to eat raw, so we baked them.
translation: Яблоки были слишком кислыми, чтобы есть сырыми, и мы их запекли.

definition: an area of calm sea water separated from the ocean by sand or rock
sentence: Children swam in the warm {lagoon} behind the reef.
translation: Дети купались в тёплой лагуне за рифом.

definition: to persuade someone to do something by offering something nice
sentence: Free samples are meant to {entice} shoppers into the store.
translation: Бесплатные образцы призваны заманить покупателей в магазин.

definition: a small plastic case with tape inside for recording sound, used in the past
sentence: He found a {cassette} of his father's band in the attic.
translation: На чердаке он нашёл кассету с записью отцовской группы.

definition: to claim to be or do something, often falsely
sentence: The letters {purport} to come from the bank, but they are fakes.
translation: Письма якобы от банка, но это подделки.

definition: a short well-known saying that gives advice or a truth
sentence: 'Look before you leap' is a {proverb} every child learns.
translation: «Семь раз отмерь, один отрежь» — пословица, которую учит каждый ребёнок.

definition: to take the dirt or poison out of something
sentence: The tablets {purify} river water so it is safe to drink.
translation: Таблетки очищают речную воду, делая её пригодной для питья.

definition: the act of leaving something out, or the thing left out
sentence: The {omission} of her name from the list was a mistake.
translation: Отсутствие её имени в списке было ошибкой.

definition: a person with extreme beliefs or an extreme interest in something
sentence: My uncle is a football {fanatic} and never misses a game.
translation: Мой дядя — фанатик футбола и не пропускает ни одной игры.

definition: to take weapons away from someone, or to make someone less angry
sentence: The police managed to {disarm} the man without a shot.
translation: Полиции удалось обезоружить мужчину без единого выстрела.

definition: the main character who opposes the hero in a story, or an opponent
sentence: The {antagonist} of the film is a charming but cruel banker.
translation: Антагонист фильма — обаятельный, но жестокий банкир.

definition: to lose a right or possession because you broke a rule
sentence: If you cancel late you {forfeit} the deposit.
translation: Если отменить поздно, вы теряете задаток.

definition: a soldier or guard who watches for danger
sentence: A {sentinel} stood at the gate all night.
translation: Часовой стоял у ворот всю ночь.

definition: to say something again to make it very clear
sentence: Let me {reiterate}: the deadline is Friday, not Monday.
translation: Повторю ещё раз: срок — пятница, а не понедельник.

definition: to send out heat, light or energy, or to show a feeling strongly
sentence: The stove will {radiate} heat long after the fire dies.
translation: Печь будет излучать тепло ещё долго после того, как погаснет огонь.

definition: to cut the wool off a sheep, or to cut or break something with force
sentence: Farmers {shear} the sheep in early summer before the heat.
translation: Фермеры стригут овец в начале лета, до жары.

definition: to punish someone for harming you or someone you love
sentence: He swore to {avenge} his brother's death.
translation: Он поклялся отомстить за смерть брата.

definition: the act of entering a place or situation where you are not wanted
sentence: The journalists' questions were an {intrusion} into her grief.
translation: Вопросы журналистов были вторжением в её горе.

definition: to treat someone cruelly over a long time because of their race, religion or beliefs
sentence: The regime began to {persecute} anyone who spoke the old language.
translation: Режим стал преследовать всех, кто говорил на старом языке.

definition: a report of a person's death in a newspaper, with an account of their life
sentence: The paper printed a long {obituary} of the old actor.
translation: Газета напечатала длинный некролог о старом актёре.

definition: a cruel ruler who has total power
sentence: The {tyrant} jailed anyone who laughed at his speeches.
translation: Тиран сажал в тюрьму всех, кто смеялся над его речами.

definition: a person who makes beautiful or useful things skilfully by hand
sentence: A local {craftsman} carved the new door for the church.
translation: Местный мастер вырезал новую дверь для церкви.

definition: a disadvantage or problem that makes something less good
sentence: The only {drawback} of the flat is the noisy street.
translation: Единственный минус квартиры — шумная улица.

definition: to take control of a plane or vehicle by force
sentence: Armed men tried to {hijack} the plane over the sea.
translation: Вооружённые люди пытались захватить самолёт над морем.

definition: the official ending of a law, system or practice
sentence: The {abolition} of slavery took decades of struggle.
translation: Отмена рабства потребовала десятилетий борьбы.

definition: how easy something is to reach, enter or use, especially for disabled people
sentence: The new ramp improved the {accessibility} of the library.
translation: Новый пандус сделал библиотеку доступнее.

definition: to make someone familiar with something
sentence: Please {acquaint} the new staff with the fire exits.
translation: Пожалуйста, ознакомьте новых сотрудников с пожарными выходами.

definition: in a voice that other people can hear
sentence: She read the letter {aloud} to the whole family.
translation: Она прочитала письмо вслух всей семье.

definition: having sharp corners, or thin with bones that show
sentence: His {angular} face looked harder in the lamplight.
translation: Его угловатое лицо в свете лампы казалось жёстче.

definition: at or near the front of the body, in medical language
sentence: The scan showed damage to the {anterior} part of the knee.
translation: Снимок показал повреждение передней части колена.

definition: a small organ in the belly, or extra pages at the back of a book
sentence: The surgeon removed her {appendix} before it burst.
translation: Хирург удалил ей аппендикс, пока он не лопнул.

definition: the part of a theatre or hall where the audience sits
sentence: The {auditorium} fell silent when the lights went down.
translation: Зрительный зал затих, когда погас свет.

definition: not harmful, or not likely to cause death, used about illness
sentence: The lump turned out to be {benign} and needed no treatment.
translation: Опухоль оказалась доброкачественной и не требовала лечения.

definition: a strong alcoholic drink made from wine
sentence: He warmed the {brandy} in his hands before drinking it.
translation: Он согрел бренди в ладонях, прежде чем выпить.

definition: the point just before something new or dangerous happens
sentence: The bank was on the {brink} of collapse when the state stepped in.
translation: Банк был на грани краха, когда вмешалось государство.

definition: slightly rude but in a funny way
sentence: The {cheeky} boy asked the teacher if she had done her homework.
translation: Дерзкий мальчик спросил учительницу, сделала ли она домашнее задание.

definition: the shape of the land along the edge of the sea
sentence: The {coastline} here is rocky with small hidden beaches.
translation: Береговая линия здесь скалистая, с маленькими скрытыми пляжами.

definition: a poisonous snake that spreads the skin of its neck when angry
sentence: The {cobra} raised its head and hissed at the dog.
translation: Кобра подняла голову и зашипела на собаку.

definition: when compared with something else
sentence: The flat is {comparatively} cheap for this part of town.
translation: Квартира сравнительно дешёвая для этого района.

definition: the whole universe, seen as an ordered system
sentence: The telescope lets us see the {cosmos} as it was billions of years ago.
translation: Телескоп позволяет увидеть космос таким, каким он был миллиарды лет назад.

definition: believing things that are not true
sentence: You are {delusional} if you think the car will last another year.
translation: Ты бредишь, если думаешь, что машина протянет ещё год.

definition: a formal written statement made by a witness for use in court
sentence: The witness gave a {deposition} before the trial began.
translation: Свидетель дал письменные показания до начала суда.

definition: careful and continued hard work
sentence: Her {diligence} in checking every figure saved the company a fortune.
translation: Её усердие в проверке каждой цифры сэкономило компании целое состояние.

definition: the fans of a particular person, team or series, considered together
sentence: The show's {fandom} wrote thousands of stories about the characters.
translation: Фандом сериала написал тысячи историй о его героях.

definition: a short holiday, or an escape after a crime
sentence: They booked a weekend {getaway} in a cottage by the lake.
translation: Они забронировали домик у озера на выходные.

definition: the attractive and exciting quality of famous or rich people and places
sentence: The {glamour} of the film world hides a lot of hard work.
translation: За блеском мира кино скрывается много тяжёлой работы.

definition: used to add something that is not the main subject
sentence: {Incidentally}, the cafe you liked has closed.
translation: Кстати, то кафе, которое тебе нравилось, закрылось.

definition: very much, or without any limit
sentence: Life is {infinitely} easier with a dishwasher.
translation: С посудомоечной машиной жизнь бесконечно легче.

definition: a serious illness like a very bad cold with fever, the full name of flu
sentence: The {influenza} of 1918 killed more people than the war.
translation: Грипп 1918 года убил больше людей, чем война.

definition: designed to teach people how to do something
sentence: The {instructional} video shows how to change a tyre.
translation: Обучающее видео показывает, как поменять колесо.

definition: giving basic information about something at the start
sentence: The {introductory} lesson is free; the rest cost twenty each.
translation: Вводный урок бесплатный, остальные стоят по двадцать.

definition: a room or space under the roof of a building, often used for storage
sentence: We keep the old toys in the {loft}.
translation: Старые игрушки мы храним на чердаке.

definition: very much or to a very large degree
sentence: The festival has grown {massively} since the first year.
translation: Фестиваль колоссально вырос с первого года.

definition: the process of helping two sides reach an agreement
sentence: The couple tried {mediation} before going to court.
translation: Пара попробовала посредничество, прежде чем идти в суд.

definition: made of separate parts that can be joined in different ways
sentence: The {modular} sofa can be arranged to fit any room.
translation: Модульный диван можно расставить под любую комнату.

definition: the state of being a mother or father
sentence: Nothing prepares you for the tiredness of {parenthood}.
translation: Ничто не готовит тебя к усталости родительства.

definition: lasting for a very long time or happening again and again
sentence: Flooding is a {perennial} problem in the low part of town.
translation: Наводнения — вечная проблема низинной части города.

definition: the quality of continuing to try despite difficulty
sentence: Her {persistence} finally won her a place on the team.
translation: Её настойчивость наконец принесла ей место в команде.

definition: the money paid for sending a letter or parcel
sentence: The {postage} on the parcel was more than the book cost.
translation: Почтовые расходы на посылку превысили цену книги.

definition: a school for children aged three to five
sentence: Our son starts {preschool} in September.
translation: Наш сын идёт в детский сад в сентябре.

definition: relating to the correct way of doing something, especially in law
sentence: The case was dropped because of a {procedural} error by the police.
translation: Дело прекратили из-за процедурной ошибки полиции.

definition: deeply or extremely
sentence: The news {profoundly} shocked the small town.
translation: Новость глубоко потрясла маленький город.

definition: the way a word or language is spoken
sentence: Her {pronunciation} of French is better than her grammar.
translation: Её французское произношение лучше, чем грамматика.

definition: continuing in a severe way without stopping
sentence: The {relentless} rain turned the road into a river.
translation: Непрекращающийся дождь превратил дорогу в реку.

definition: the use of force to control people, or the holding back of feelings
sentence: Years of {repression} ended when the old regime fell.
translation: Годы репрессий закончились с падением старого режима.

definition: in a way that is extreme and deserves to be laughed at
sentence: The hotel was {ridiculously} expensive for what it offered.
translation: Отель был смехотворно дорогим для того, что предлагал.

definition: a fight with guns, or a way to decide a drawn match
sentence: Two officers were hurt in a {shootout} with the robbers.
translation: Двое полицейских пострадали в перестрелке с грабителями.

definition: based on guessing, or involving risk in the hope of profit
sentence: The report is {speculative}; nobody has seen the figures.
translation: Отчёт построен на догадках, цифр никто не видел.

definition: to go or put something under the surface of water
sentence: The floods will {submerge} the fields along the river.
translation: Паводок затопит поля вдоль реки.

definition: the quality of having two halves that match exactly
sentence: The {symmetry} of the butterfly's wings is perfect.
translation: Симметрия крыльев бабочки совершенна.

definition: able to be trusted
sentence: Leave the keys with a {trustworthy} neighbour.
translation: Оставь ключи надёжному соседу.

definition: coming after eleven others in a series
sentence: Her {twelfth} birthday fell on a Sunday this year.
translation: Её двенадцатый день рождения в этом году выпал на воскресенье.

definition: a medical test that uses sound waves to make pictures inside the body
sentence: The {ultrasound} showed that the baby was a girl.
translation: УЗИ показало, что будет девочка.

definition: relating to the tubes that carry blood through the body
sentence: Smoking damages the {vascular} system over time.
translation: Курение со временем разрушает сосудистую систему.

definition: good for your health or morally good
sentence: The farm serves a {wholesome} breakfast of eggs and bread.
translation: На ферме подают полезный завтрак из яиц и хлеба.

definition: a long sharp tooth of a snake, dog or wolf
sentence: The dog bared a yellow {fang} at the stranger.
translation: Собака оскалила жёлтый клык на незнакомца.

definition: a unit of computer information equal to eight bits, enough for one letter
sentence: A single {byte} stores one letter of text.
translation: Один байт хранит одну букву текста.

definition: a large flying insect like a wasp with a painful sting
sentence: A {hornet} the size of a thumb flew in through the window.
translation: В окно влетел шершень размером с большой палец.

definition: to turn over the soil with a large tool before planting, in American English
sentence: The farmer will {plow} the field before the rain comes.
translation: Фермер вспашет поле до дождя.

definition: to limit what someone or something can do
sentence: Lack of money will {constrain} the museum's plans.
translation: Нехватка денег ограничит планы музея.

definition: a person who writes plays
sentence: The {playwright} watched the first night from the back row.
translation: Драматург смотрел премьеру с заднего ряда.

definition: to make something change direction, or to turn attention away from something
sentence: The goalkeeper managed to {deflect} the ball over the bar.
translation: Вратарь сумел отбить мяч над перекладиной.

definition: to show or state that something is true
sentence: The old photographs {attest} to how much the town has changed.
translation: Старые фотографии свидетельствуют о том, как изменился город.

definition: to break a law or a right
sentence: Copying the design would {infringe} the company's patent.
translation: Копирование дизайна нарушило бы патент компании.

definition: a thick mass of blood that has become almost solid
sentence: A {clot} in the leg can travel to the lungs and be dangerous.
translation: Тромб в ноге может попасть в лёгкие и стать опасным.

definition: to secretly plan with others to do something illegal or harmful
sentence: The three men were accused of trying to {conspire} against the king.
translation: Троих мужчин обвинили в заговоре против короля.

definition: to put more bullets into a gun, or to load a page or program again
sentence: {Reload} the page if the pictures do not appear.
translation: Перезагрузи страницу, если картинки не появляются.

definition: the pedal in a car that makes it go faster
sentence: Her foot slipped from the {accelerator} onto the brake.
translation: Её нога соскользнула с педали газа на тормоз.

definition: to hide something by making it look like its surroundings
sentence: Soldiers {camouflage} the tanks with branches and nets.
translation: Солдаты маскируют танки ветками и сетями.

definition: an adult male chicken
sentence: The {rooster} wakes the whole village at five.
translation: Петух будит всю деревню в пять утра.

definition: a long thin fish that looks like a snake
sentence: The fisherman pulled a slippery {eel} from the net.
translation: Рыбак вытащил из сети скользкого угря.

definition: a person who secretly gives information to the police or an organisation
sentence: The police paid an {informant} inside the gang.
translation: Полиция платила информатору внутри банды.

definition: a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal to live in
sentence: The rabbit disappeared into its {burrow} under the hedge.
translation: Кролик скрылся в своей норе под изгородью.

definition: to bend your knees and lower your body close to the ground
sentence: The photographer had to {crouch} to get the child in the frame.
translation: Фотографу пришлось присесть, чтобы ребёнок попал в кадр.

definition: a person who moves over snow on skis
sentence: The {skier} came down the slope at eighty kilometres an hour.
translation: Лыжник спускался по склону со скоростью восемьдесят километров в час.

definition: to turn information into a code so that only certain people can read it
sentence: The app will {encrypt} every message before it leaves your phone.
translation: Приложение шифрует каждое сообщение, прежде чем оно покинет телефон.

definition: the front of a large building, or a false appearance
sentence: The {facade} of the bank is covered in white marble.
translation: Фасад банка облицован белым мрамором.

definition: an African animal like a horse with black and white stripes
sentence: A {zebra} grazed beside the road as we drove past.
translation: Зебра паслась у дороги, когда мы проезжали мимо.

definition: to ask someone for money, help or information in a formal way
sentence: The charity will {solicit} donations from local businesses.
translation: Благотворительная организация будет собирать пожертвования у местных компаний.

definition: the taking of a house by a bank because the owner cannot pay the loan
sentence: The family lost their home to {foreclosure} after he lost his job.
translation: Семья лишилась дома по взысканию банка после того, как он потерял работу.

definition: a person who asks for money or a right that they believe they are owed
sentence: Each {claimant} must show proof of the damage.
translation: Каждый заявитель должен предоставить доказательства ущерба.

definition: a small round dark blue fruit that grows on a bush
sentence: She dropped a {blueberry} into each muffin.
translation: Она положила по чернике в каждый маффин.

definition: to be greater in number than another group
sentence: Sheep {outnumber} people on the island ten to one.
translation: Овец на острове в десять раз больше, чем людей.

definition: to improve a skill by practising, or to sharpen a blade
sentence: She spent years working to {hone} her drawing.
translation: Она годами оттачивала своё мастерство рисунка.

definition: a sudden loud burst of air from the nose and mouth
sentence: A loud {sneeze} broke the silence of the library.
translation: Громкий чих нарушил тишину библиотеки.

definition: a person whose job is to sell or advertise products
sentence: A good {marketer} knows which words make people buy.
translation: Хороший маркетолог знает, какие слова заставляют людей покупать.

definition: to touch or change something without permission, often to damage it
sentence: Someone tried to {tamper} with the lock on the back door.
translation: Кто-то пытался вскрыть замок на задней двери.

definition: a green plant with long feathery leaves and no flowers
sentence: A {fern} grew in the damp corner of the garden.
translation: Папоротник рос в сыром углу сада.

definition: to turn something upside down or put it in the opposite order
sentence: {Invert} the cake onto a plate while it is still warm.
translation: Переверни торт на тарелку, пока он ещё тёплый.

definition: a large company made up of several different businesses
sentence: The {conglomerate} owns hotels, airlines and a television channel.
translation: Конгломерат владеет отелями, авиакомпаниями и телеканалом.

definition: a person who lives by asking people for money or food
sentence: A {beggar} sat at the church door with an empty cup.
translation: Нищий сидел у дверей церкви с пустой чашкой.

definition: a typical feature of a person or thing, or an official mark on gold
sentence: Careful detail is the {hallmark} of her paintings.
translation: Тщательная проработка деталей — отличительная черта её картин.

definition: a long wooden seat in a church
sentence: The family sat in the front {pew} every Sunday.
translation: Семья каждое воскресенье сидела на передней скамье в церкви.

definition: to force someone to leave a house or land, usually by law
sentence: The landlord can {evict} tenants who do not pay for three months.
translation: Домовладелец может выселить жильцов, не платящих три месяца.

definition: a small square of rich chocolate cake
sentence: She baked a tray of {brownies} for the school fair.
translation: Она испекла противень брауни для школьной ярмарки.

definition: a small soft creature like a snail without a shell
sentence: A {slug} had eaten half the lettuce overnight.
translation: Слизень за ночь съел половину салата.

definition: a person kept in prison, usually without a trial, for political reasons
sentence: Each {detainee} was allowed one visit a month.
translation: Каждому задержанному разрешалось одно свидание в месяц.

definition: to be next to or joined with something
sentence: The garage and the kitchen {adjoin}, so you can carry the shopping straight in.
translation: Гараж примыкает к кухне, так что покупки можно сразу занести внутрь.

definition: the family or people from whom you are descended
sentence: Her {ancestry} is half Irish and half Italian.
translation: Её корни наполовину ирландские, наполовину итальянские.

definition: to take control of a country or area by force
sentence: The empire moved to {annex} the small kingdom in the north.
translation: Империя решила присоединить маленькое северное королевство.

definition: extremely interested in and enthusiastic about something
sentence: My grandmother is an {avid} reader of crime novels.
translation: Моя бабушка — страстная любительница детективов.

definition: a tree with thin branches and smooth white outer wood
sentence: A silver {birch} stood at the end of the garden.
translation: В конце сада стояла серебристая берёза.

definition: without a strong taste, or dull and uninteresting
sentence: The soup was {bland}, so I added salt and pepper.
translation: Суп был пресным, и я добавил соль и перец.

definition: relating to a bride or a wedding
sentence: The {bridal} shop sells dresses from every decade.
translation: В свадебном салоне продаются платья всех десятилетий.

definition: a vegetable with a thick green stem and small dark green flower heads
sentence: Steam the {broccoli} for four minutes so it stays bright green.
translation: Готовь брокколи на пару четыре минуты, чтобы она осталась ярко-зелёной.

definition: rather cold, or not friendly
sentence: The evening turned {chilly}, so we went inside.
translation: Вечером похолодало, и мы ушли в дом.

definition: an alcoholic drink made from apples
sentence: We drank cold {cider} under the apple trees.
translation: Мы пили холодный сидр под яблонями.

definition: having no idea about something
sentence: He is {clueless} about cars and calls a mechanic for everything.
translation: Он ничего не понимает в машинах и по любому поводу вызывает механика.

definition: in a deliberate and aware way
sentence: She {consciously} slowed her breathing before the speech.
translation: Она сознательно замедлила дыхание перед речью.

definition: a small bed for a baby that can be rocked
sentence: The baby slept in a wooden {cradle} by the fire.
translation: Малыш спал в деревянной колыбели у камина.

definition: honest and fair behaviour that shows respect for others
sentence: He at least had the {decency} to apologise.
translation: У него хотя бы хватило порядочности извиниться.

definition: the area that a bishop is in charge of
sentence: The {diocese} covers forty parishes along the coast.
translation: Епархия охватывает сорок приходов вдоль побережья.

definition: the step in front of a door, or the area just outside a house
sentence: Someone left a basket of apples on the {doorstep}.
translation: Кто-то оставил корзину яблок на пороге.

definition: a secure position for your feet, or the basis on which something exists
sentence: She lost her {footing} on the ice and fell.
translation: Она потеряла равновесие на льду и упала.

definition: attractive and exciting in the way of rich and famous people
sentence: The job sounds {glamorous}, but it is mostly airports and hotels.
translation: Работа звучит гламурно, но это в основном аэропорты и отели.

definition: great damage and disorder
sentence: The storm caused {havoc} on the roads and railways.
translation: Буря вызвала хаос на дорогах и железной дороге.

definition: having or showing hatred of gay people
sentence: The club banned a fan for {homophobic} chants.
translation: Клуб отстранил болельщика за гомофобные выкрики.

definition: warm and with a lot of water in the air
sentence: The summer is hot and {humid}, so everything feels sticky.
translation: Лето жаркое и влажное, всё кажется липким.

definition: not having much knowledge or skill because you have not done something long
sentence: An {inexperienced} driver should avoid the motorway at night.
translation: Неопытному водителю лучше избегать автомагистрали ночью.

definition: the biggest prize in a lottery or game
sentence: Nobody won the {jackpot}, so it rolls over to next week.
translation: Джекпот никто не выиграл, и он переходит на следующую неделю.

definition: while knowing that something is wrong or true
sentence: He {knowingly} sold a car with faulty brakes.
translation: Он сознательно продал машину с неисправными тормозами.

definition: a political belief in freedom, equal rights and gradual change
sentence: The party's {liberalism} attracted young voters in the cities.
translation: Либерализм партии привлёк молодых избирателей в городах.

definition: a word or phrase repeated often, in prayer or as a rule for life
sentence: 'Measure twice, cut once' is the carpenter's {mantra}.
translation: «Семь раз отмерь, один раз отрежь» — мантра плотника.

definition: an instrument that makes very small things look much bigger
sentence: Under the {microscope} the drop of water was full of life.
translation: Под микроскопом капля воды оказалась полна жизни.

definition: containing a lot of the white drink from cows, or white and cloudy like it
sentence: A {milky} mist hung over the fields at dawn.
translation: Молочная дымка висела над полями на рассвете.

definition: very large, important or impressive
sentence: Building the dam was a {monumental} task that took a decade.
translation: Строительство плотины было грандиозной задачей, занявшей десятилетие.

definition: a person or thing that annoys you or causes small problems
sentence: The mosquitoes were a real {nuisance} on the terrace.
translation: Комары на террасе были настоящей напастью.

definition: the act of doing what you are told to do
sentence: The dog went to {obedience} classes for six weeks.
translation: Собака шесть недель ходила на курсы послушания.

definition: not done or paid by the expected time
sentence: The library book is two weeks {overdue}.
translation: Библиотечная книга просрочена на две недели.

definition: that must or can be paid
sentence: The fee is {payable} within thirty days of the invoice.
translation: Плата вносится в течение тридцати дней с момента выставления счёта.

definition: pretty in a way that looks like a picture, used about places
sentence: The {picturesque} village has a stone bridge and a mill.
translation: В живописной деревне есть каменный мост и мельница.

definition: a journey to a holy place for religious reasons
sentence: Every year thousands make the {pilgrimage} to the mountain shrine.
translation: Каждый год тысячи людей совершают паломничество к горному святилищу.

definition: to turn on a central point, or to change direction or plan completely
sentence: The company had to {pivot} from cameras to phone lenses.
translation: Компании пришлось переориентироваться с камер на объективы для телефонов.

definition: extremely important because other things depend on it
sentence: Her goal was {pivotal} in the team's win.
translation: Её гол стал решающим в победе команды.

definition: intended to stop something bad from happening
sentence: A yearly check-up is the best {preventive} medicine.
translation: Ежегодный осмотр — лучшая профилактика.

definition: the degree to which a business makes money
sentence: The new shop improved the {profitability} of the whole chain.
translation: Новый магазин повысил прибыльность всей сети.

definition: relating to the lungs
sentence: The {pulmonary} specialist ordered a scan of his chest.
translation: Пульмонолог назначил ему снимок грудной клетки.

definition: a return to an earlier or worse state, or a statistical method
sentence: The patient showed {regression} after a month of progress.
translation: После месяца улучшений у пациента наступил откат.

definition: able to recover quickly from difficulty or damage
sentence: Children are {resilient} and adapt to a new school in weeks.
translation: Дети выносливы и привыкают к новой школе за несколько недель.

definition: having the same meaning, or closely connected with something
sentence: The brand has become {synonymous} with cheap flights.
translation: Бренд стал синонимом дешёвых перелётов.

definition: boring and lasting too long
sentence: Filling in those forms is a {tedious} job.
translation: Заполнять эти формы — нудное занятие.

definition: the use of something in an effective way
sentence: The {utilization} of the hospital beds rose to ninety percent.
translation: Загруженность больничных коек выросла до девяноста процентов.

definition: a small gun with a round part that turns to hold the bullets
sentence: The sheriff kept a {revolver} in his desk drawer.
translation: Шериф держал револьвер в ящике стола.

definition: a person who treats someone cruelly, or who uses drugs or alcohol too much
sentence: The court kept the {abuser} away from the family home.
translation: Суд запретил насильнику приближаться к семейному дому.

definition: a singer, especially in a band
sentence: The band is looking for a new {vocalist} after the singer left.
translation: Группа ищет нового вокалиста после ухода певца.

definition: to stop resisting something, or to die from an illness
sentence: After an hour he began to {succumb} to the cold.
translation: Через час он стал поддаваться холоду.

definition: a short story with animals as characters that teaches a lesson
sentence: The {fable} of the hare and the tortoise teaches patience.
translation: Басня о зайце и черепахе учит терпению.

definition: a large crowd of people moving in a noisy uncontrolled way
sentence: A {horde} of shoppers rushed through the doors at nine.
translation: Орда покупателей хлынула в двери в девять.

definition: a deep valley with very high rock walls on both sides
sentence: The river cut a {gorge} through the mountain over millions of years.
translation: Река за миллионы лет прорезала ущелье в горе.

definition: to pay part of the cost of something to keep its price low
sentence: The state will {subsidize} bus tickets for students.
translation: Государство будет субсидировать автобусные билеты для студентов.

definition: a word made from the first letters of other words, such as NATO
sentence: NASA is an {acronym} for the American space agency.
translation: НАСА — аббревиатура американского космического агентства.

definition: a person who has ideas that are not practical, or who imagines a better future
sentence: Every great inventor was once called a {dreamer}.
translation: Каждого великого изобретателя когда-то называли мечтателем.

definition: a feeling of worry that stops you doing or saying what you want
sentence: After a glass of wine she lost her {inhibition} and sang.
translation: После бокала вина она избавилась от скованности и запела.

definition: a painful swelling on the skin filled with liquid, often from rubbing
sentence: New boots gave him a {blister} on each heel.
translation: Новые ботинки натёрли ему волдыри на обеих пятках.

definition: a person who cuts and arranges hair, or who chooses clothes for others
sentence: The {stylist} suggested a shorter cut for the summer.
translation: Стилист предложила на лето стрижку покороче.

definition: a unit of weight equal to a thousand grams
sentence: He bought a {kilo} of apples at the market.
translation: Он купил на рынке килограмм яблок.

definition: a person who drives a car
sentence: Every {motorist} on the road was stuck for two hours.
translation: Все автомобилисты на дороге застряли на два часа.

definition: a channel at the edge of a roof or road that carries rainwater away
sentence: Clear the leaves from the {gutter} before the autumn rain.
translation: Прочисти водосток от листьев до осенних дождей.

definition: a very small piece of bread, cake or biscuit
sentence: The birds ate every {crumb} we dropped on the ground.
translation: Птицы склевали каждую крошку, которую мы уронили на землю.

definition: to make someone drunk or excited so they lose control
sentence: Two glasses of the strong wine were enough to {intoxicate} him.
translation: Двух бокалов крепкого вина хватило, чтобы он опьянел.

definition: a substance such as glue used to stick things together
sentence: Use a strong {adhesive} to fix the tile to the wall.
translation: Используй сильный клей, чтобы прикрепить плитку к стене.

definition: to spend time with other people in a friendly way
sentence: After work the team likes to {socialize} at the pub.
translation: После работы команда любит общаться в пабе.

definition: a short journey to do a small job, such as buying something
sentence: She sent the boy on an {errand} to the bakery.
translation: Она послала мальчика с поручением в пекарню.

definition: a religious official in a Christian church, below a priest
sentence: The {deacon} read the lesson at the morning service.
translation: Диакон читал Писание на утренней службе.

definition: the part of a car over the wheel that protects it from mud
sentence: The {fender} was dented where the trolley had hit it.
translation: Крыло машины было помято там, где в него врезалась тележка.

definition: a soldier trained to make quick attacks in enemy areas
sentence: A {commando} unit landed on the beach before dawn.
translation: Отряд коммандос высадился на пляже до рассвета.

definition: a wrong idea that many people believe
sentence: It is a common {misconception} that bats are blind.
translation: Распространённое заблуждение, что летучие мыши слепы.

definition: to make a mistake, in formal language
sentence: It is better to {err} on the side of caution with a sick child.
translation: С больным ребёнком лучше перестраховаться.

definition: to change the meaning or nature of something
sentence: The internet has helped {redefine} what a shop is.
translation: Интернет помог переосмыслить, что такое магазин.

definition: to change and improve the appearance or structure of something
sentence: The hotel will {revamp} its restaurant with a new chef and menu.
translation: Отель обновит ресторан с новым шеф-поваром и меню.

definition: to beat someone violently, or to move about wildly
sentence: The fish began to {thrash} on the deck.
translation: Рыба забилась на палубе.

definition: a person in stories who turns into a wolf when the moon is full
sentence: The villagers blamed a {werewolf} for the lost sheep.
translation: Жители деревни винили оборотня в пропаже овец.

definition: a list of goods or services provided with the amount of money owed
sentence: Send the {invoice} to the finance department by Friday.
translation: Отправь счёт в финансовый отдел до пятницы.

definition: a person trained to help women when they give birth
sentence: The {midwife} stayed with her through the whole night.
translation: Акушерка оставалась с ней всю ночь.

definition: someone who acts in place of another, especially a woman carrying a baby for others
sentence: The couple had a son with the help of a {surrogate}.
translation: У пары родился сын с помощью суррогатной матери.

definition: extremely large, or relating to the study of stars
sentence: The cost of the new stadium was {astronomical}.
translation: Стоимость нового стадиона была астрономической.

definition: clothes, especially of a formal or particular kind
sentence: Guests were asked to wear formal {attire} to the dinner.
translation: Гостей попросили прийти на ужин в вечерней одежде.

definition: a grain used for making beer and soup and for feeding animals
sentence: The field of {barley} turned gold in July.
translation: Поле ячменя стало золотым в июле.

definition: relating to plants or the study of plants
sentence: The {botanical} garden has a glasshouse full of tropical trees.
translation: В ботаническом саду есть оранжерея с тропическими деревьями.

definition: an escape from prison, or a sudden success
sentence: Three prisoners escaped in a {breakout} last night.
translation: Прошлой ночью трое заключённых совершили побег.

definition: easy to remember and pleasant to hear, used about music or phrases
sentence: The advert's {catchy} tune stayed in my head all day.
translation: Прилипчивый мотив из рекламы весь день крутился у меня в голове.

definition: used in or connected with a formal ceremony
sentence: The queen's role is mostly {ceremonial} these days.
translation: Роль королевы в наши дни в основном церемониальная.

definition: the art of designing the steps and movements of a dance
sentence: The {choreography} of the final scene took weeks to learn.
translation: Хореографию финальной сцены учили несколько недель.

definition: happening at the same time
sentence: He is serving two {concurrent} sentences of five years.
translation: Он отбывает два параллельных срока по пять лет.

definition: the act of showing or seeing a difference between things
sentence: Clear {differentiation} between the two products helps buyers choose.
translation: Чёткое различие между двумя продуктами помогает покупателям выбрать.

definition: not sure whether something is good or true, or probably not honest
sentence: The shop has a {dubious} reputation for returns.
translation: У магазина сомнительная репутация в вопросе возвратов.

definition: with great interest and excitement
sentence: The children waited {eagerly} for the parcel to be opened.
translation: Дети с нетерпением ждали, когда откроют посылку.

definition: relating to the Christian church or its priests
sentence: The {ecclesiastical} court decided the dispute between the two parishes.
translation: Церковный суд разрешил спор между двумя приходами.

definition: a very large deer with wide flat horns from the north
sentence: An {elk} stood in the river eating water plants.
translation: Лось стоял в реке и ел водные растения.

definition: the state of being extremely tired
sentence: The runner collapsed from {exhaustion} at the finish line.
translation: Бегун рухнул от истощения на финише.

definition: the feeling that something is about to happen, or an expected length of life
sentence: Life {expectancy} in the country rose to eighty years.
translation: Ожидаемая продолжительность жизни в стране выросла до восьмидесяти лет.

definition: in a way that is well known, or very
sentence: The actor {famously} refused to fly and crossed the ocean by ship.
translation: Актёр, как известно, отказывался летать и пересекал океан на корабле.

definition: the traditional stories and customs of a people
sentence: Local {folklore} says the lake has no bottom.
translation: По местным преданиям, у озера нет дна.

definition: relating to a galaxy, especially the Milky Way
sentence: The probe left the solar system and entered {galactic} space.
translation: Зонд покинул Солнечную систему и вошёл в галактическое пространство.

definition: a feeling of great happiness, often at someone else's bad luck
sentence: The children watched with {glee} as the teacher slipped on the ice.
translation: Дети с восторгом смотрели, как учитель поскользнулся на льду.

definition: involving ordinary people rather than leaders or officials
sentence: The party began as a {grassroots} movement in small towns.
translation: Партия началась как низовое движение в маленьких городах.

definition: relating to the force that pulls objects towards each other
sentence: The moon's {gravitational} pull causes the tides.
translation: Гравитационное притяжение Луны вызывает приливы.

definition: passed from parents to children through the genes, or by right of birth
sentence: The disease is {hereditary} and runs in his family.
translation: Болезнь наследственная и передаётся в его семье.

definition: a pause in an activity
sentence: The band took a two-year {hiatus} before the new album.
translation: Группа взяла двухлетний перерыв перед новым альбомом.

definition: a farmhouse with the land and buildings around it
sentence: The old {homestead} still stands at the end of the dirt road.
translation: Старая усадьба всё ещё стоит в конце грунтовой дороги.

definition: in a very bad or unpleasant way, or very
sentence: The plan went {horribly} wrong when the rain started.
translation: План ужасно провалился, когда начался дождь.

definition: a unit for measuring the power of an engine
sentence: The new engine produces three hundred {horsepower}.
translation: Новый двигатель выдаёт триста лошадиных сил.

definition: a sweet mixture of sugar and water or butter spread on cakes
sentence: The children spread pink {icing} on the biscuits.
translation: Дети намазали печенье розовой глазурью.

definition: the ability to think and understand ideas
sentence: Her {intellect} impressed every teacher she had.
translation: Её ум впечатлял каждого её учителя.

definition: a place where roads join so cars can change roads, or an exchange
sentence: Leave the motorway at the next {interchange} and turn north.
translation: Съезжай с автомагистрали на следующей развязке и поворачивай на север.

definition: a book or file in which a business records money received and spent
sentence: Every sale is written in the {ledger} by hand.
translation: Каждая продажа записывается в бухгалтерскую книгу от руки.

definition: a light silver-white metal that burns with a bright white flame
sentence: Green vegetables are a good source of {magnesium}.
translation: Зелёные овощи — хороший источник магния.

definition: aware of something and careful about it, or giving full attention to the present
sentence: Be {mindful} of the ice on the steps.
translation: Помни о льде на ступеньках.

definition: very many, used in formal or literary language
sentence: The night sky showed {myriad} stars above the desert.
translation: Ночное небо над пустыней было усыпано бесчисленными звёздами.

definition: relating to the nose, or sounding as if spoken through the nose
sentence: The cold left her with a {nasal} voice for a week.
translation: После простуды у неё неделю был гнусавый голос.

definition: relating to ships, sailors and the sea
sentence: The museum is full of {nautical} maps and old compasses.
translation: Музей полон морских карт и старых компасов.

definition: in a tidy and careful way
sentence: She folded the letter {neatly} and put it in the envelope.
translation: Она аккуратно сложила письмо и положила в конверт.

definition: the habit of thinking about the bad side of things
sentence: His constant {negativity} made the whole team tired.
translation: Его постоянный негатив утомлял всю команду.

definition: deserving attention because it is important or interesting
sentence: It is {noteworthy} that nobody on the boat could swim.
translation: Примечательно, что никто на лодке не умел плавать.

definition: unable to do anything to stop or change something
sentence: The guards were {powerless} to stop the flood of water.
translation: Охрана была бессильна остановить поток воды.

definition: dealing with things in a practical way rather than following theory
sentence: She took a {pragmatic} view and sold the house before prices fell.
translation: Она подошла к делу практично и продала дом до падения цен.

definition: shining brightly, or looking very happy and healthy
sentence: The bride looked {radiant} as she walked down the aisle.
translation: Невеста сияла, идя к алтарю.

definition: a strong feeling of guilt and regret about something you did
sentence: The thief showed no {remorse} in court.
translation: Вор не выказал в суде никакого раскаяния.

definition: the state of having a healthy mind and sensible judgement
sentence: Walking the dog every evening keeps my {sanity} in a busy week.
translation: Вечерняя прогулка с собакой сохраняет мне рассудок в напряжённую неделю.

definition: a big argument or fight that finally settles a disagreement
sentence: The two teams meet in a {showdown} for the title on Sunday.
translation: В воскресенье две команды сойдутся в решающей битве за титул.

definition: the shape made by buildings or hills against the sky
sentence: The city's {skyline} has changed with three new towers.
translation: Силуэт города изменился с появлением трёх новых башен.
